name: Ciryl Gane

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (76 in height, 81 in reach, born 1990-04-12); heavyweight (limit 265 lb); his exact 2026 weigh-in weight was not checked.

photo_coverage: Very good. Studio headshot and two full-body cut-outs (one in the June 2026 UFC Freedom 250 kit), five public-domain U.S. government photos from May-June 2026 (Oval Office frontal in daylight, high-resolution walkout three-quarter, ceremonial weigh-in upper body, full-body walkout), a CC BY 2022 daylight three-quarter, and two June 2026 weigh-in photos (face-off near-profile of his left side, double-biceps pose). No clean 90-degree profile in neutral light. His last fight in data/derived/fighters.json is 2026-06-14.

face.shape: Long rectangular-oval face on a large, long head; the lower third is long and strong, the forehead high and broad.
face.jaw: Broad and strong with defined angles; the trimmed beard makes the jawline crisp and squared.
face.chin: Broad, fairly long and moderately projecting; square-rounded under the beard.
face.cheekbones: High and moderately prominent; cheeks lean with slight hollows below the cheekbones at rest; they lift high in his wide smile (Freedom 250 walkout photo).
face.brow_ridge: Moderate; the brows sit low over heavy upper lids, giving a calm, half-lidded look.
face.forehead: High, broad and smooth, sloping back gently in profile; faint horizontal lines.
face.head_shape: Shaved skull, long front-to-back with a smooth rounded dome and a prominent, rounded back of the head (face-off near-profile, walkout photo).

eyes.shape: Almond with heavy, hooded upper lids that cover the top of the iris at rest; outer corners slightly downturned; mild under-eye bags.
eyes.colour: Dark brown. Closest MakeHuman iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Low and nearly straight with a slight arch at the middle; tails angle down a little.

nose.width: Broad at the nostrils, medium bridge
nose.tip: Broad and rounded, pointing slightly down; nostrils wide and a little flared

face.mouth_lips: Wide mouth with full lips: lower lip fuller than the upper, clear cupid's bow. At rest the lips are closed with neutral to slightly down-turned corners; his smile is wide and toothy.

ears.size: Medium, fairly close to the head, upper rim slightly flared.
ears.cauliflower_ear: No; both ears look smooth in the studio headshot and the 2026 photos.

face.marks_scars: No facial scars visible. Small horizontal scar or mark below the right pectoral (studio stance-left, weigh-in photo).

hair.style: Shaved head (clean-shaven or a 0-1 mm clipper); faint stubble shadow at the sides and back in studio light; the top is smooth and catches highlights. Same look in 2022 and 2026.
hair.colour_note: The scalp reads as skin; use a very light stubble shadow of #1e1513 at low opacity on the sides and back only.

facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin, jaw and moustache; thinner on the upper cheeks, trimmed to a low, crisp cheek line and a clean neckline.
facial_hair.shape: Short full beard about 1 cm (a little longer at the chin), connected moustache, sharp edges; boxed shape that follows the jaw.

skin.tone_hex_method: Plain RGB mean of the samples marked in_average (well-lit face patches from the two studio cut-outs plus neutral daylight photos); the heavily orange-graded studio headshot, coloured stage light and shadowed patches are excluded. Each sample is the mean of the 15th-85th luma-percentile pixels of the patch.

body_samples.where: chest, lit side, clear of tattoo (studio)

skin.tone_note: Medium brown. The studio cut-outs are warm/orange; the Oval Office daylight samples are a little less saturated (about #ba8574), so stay between the two.
skin.freckles_marks: Even complexion; no notable facial marks. Scar mark below the right pectoral.

body.build: Tall (193 cm), long-limbed heavyweight with an athletic, mobile look rather than bulky; long arms (206 cm reach) and long legs.
body.body_fat_note: Upper abs and chest edges visible; some softness at the lower abdomen and flanks (studio cut-outs, June 2026 weigh-in).
body.shoulders: Broad and rounded with large deltoids.
body.arms: Long and muscular; big triceps and biceps in the weigh-in flex; strong forearms.
body.legs_calves: Long legs, strong thighs, long shins and relatively slim calves.
body.posture: Upright and relaxed, shoulders rolled slightly forward, hands loose; light and springy when walking.
body.notable: Long head on a long, strong neck, shaved scalp, trimmed black beard, and the large chest tattoo are the strongest cues; overall length of limbs matters more than bulk.

tattoos.where: Upper chest, centred on the sternum between the collarbones and pectorals
tattoos.description: Black-ink radial ornament in a Thai sak-yant-like style: a central ring/oval enclosing lines of script, surrounded by spiky sun-ray or flame points with small curled glyph clusters.

tattoos.where: Left thigh, front, just above the knee
tattoos.description: BON GAMIN (his nickname) in bold black capital letters, with a thin line of smaller script beneath.

tattoos.where: Both shins (front of the lower legs)
tattoos.description: Tall, narrow vertical ornamental lettering/monogram designs in black line work; the more visible one is on the left shin.
None visible on the arms; back not seen in these photos.

kit.fight_shorts_recent: UFC Freedom 250 (June 2026): white shorts with a navy waistband with white stars, light-blue pinstripes and red/white stripes at the hem; blue Freedom 250 gloves; navy/red star-pattern Venum walkout shirt.
kit.fight_shorts_standard: White UFC shorts with grey/black brush-stroke pattern and black waistband (ESPN stance-left).
kit.weigh_in: Navy UFC sweat shorts with a red drawstring; orange/red UFC wristband.

morphs_height_note: macro/heightUpM 0.33 from the research/assets.md male fit heightUpM = 2 * (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 with H = 1.930 m; if the avatar code scales to the tale of the tape directly, this value can be dropped.

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets are not in assets/embed/mh-manifest.json. His ears are close to the base mesh; none are needed.

render_hints.skin_base: mh-skin-young_african_male or middleage_african_male tinted toward #be7f67 (lighter and warmer than both swatches)
render_hints.hair: no hair mesh; shaved scalp with a faint stubble shadow on the sides/back
render_hints.beard: short full-beard texture/shell #221412 with a crisp low cheek line and clean neckline
render_hints.tattoos: chest ornament, BON GAMIN on the left thigh above the knee, vertical designs on both shins (decals if the skin pipeline supports them)

notes: Confidence: high for head shape, shaved scalp, beard, build and tattoos (studio cut-outs plus several public-domain 2026 photos). Medium-high for face proportions; the studio headshot is heavily orange-graded, so trust the Oval Office daylight photo for colour. Watch for: (1) long head and long face, high forehead, strong long chin; (2) heavy hooded eyelids with slightly downturned outer corners (calm, sleepy look); (3) broad nose and full lips with a wide mouth; (4) tall 193 cm frame with long arms and legs and only average body-fat; (5) the chest tattoo sits centrally on the upper chest, not on one pec.

stance.source: Set 2026-11-06 from his documented fighting style: data/scouting/ciryl-gane.json (archetype, tags, signature and summary) and widely described stance traits. The ESPN stance cutouts (espn_stance_left.png, espn_stance_right.png) are posed standing shots, so they were used only for posture, shoulder set and build, not for the guard or footwork; fight footage would sharpen these values.
stance.notes: Moves like a lighter man (scouting: constant lateral movement and stance switches), long jab out front, back-weighted to kick.
